accessories.design: A slim soft midnight-navy collar nested into the neck fur, with one small polished gold bell centered at the front and a physically connected short loop.
accessories.physics: Continuous collar around the neck; the bell remains front-center, hangs downward, and is hidden by the body from the back except for the rear collar band.

accessories.design: A soft cloud-blue knitted scarf with a thick rounded wrap, gentle folds, a side knot, two unequal curved hanging ends and small tassels.
accessories.physics: Continuous hollow wrap around the neck; tails hang under gravity, preserve thickness and stay outside the paws and torso.

accessories.design: A roomy soft felt mist-purple beret, gently tilted with an off-center crown and relaxed asymmetric drape, large enough to settle around the ear bases.
accessories.physics: Real hat cavity and rim; soft brim contacts fur, ears occupy believable space, no rigid disk, floating or penetration.

accessories.design: A small polished gold crescent-and-star hair clip attached beside the kitten's anatomical left ear.
accessories.physics: One fixed clip at the left ear base; near-side views reveal thickness and clasp, far-side and rear views obey occlusion without duplication.

accessories.design: A small-to-medium ivory satin neck bow with rounded padded loops, shallow folds, short tucked tails and one pearl center.
accessories.physics: Decorative bow remains front-center; only the thin rear collar band is visible from behind.

accessories.design: Pale mint earmuffs with one softly padded headband and two thick fluffy circular ear pads.
accessories.physics: Both pads are one connected object, centered at both ear bases and gently compressing fur; headband follows the skull behind the ear tips.

accessories.design: A warm honey-gold chunky knitted neck warmer with a thick rounded cable-knit rim and soft lower fold.
accessories.physics: Continuous hollow tube around the neck with believable thickness and compression; no hard ring or detached front plate.

accessories.design: A small pale-blue plush cloud backpack with rounded lobes, subtle piping and two soft fitted straps.
accessories.physics: Bag rests against the upper back, straps pass around the shoulders/body, remains behind the cat and is naturally hidden from strict front view.

accessories.design: A small aqua enamel fish brooch with a restrained glossy edge and tiny gold fastening detail.
accessories.physics: Pinned on the kitten's anatomical left upper chest; follows chest curvature and disappears behind the body when occluded.

accessories.design: A delicate warm-gold laurel circlet with paired raised leaves sweeping outward from the center.
accessories.physics: Curved circlet follows the forehead and ear-base contour, retains leaf thickness and a continuous rear band.

accessories.design: A soft white-and-sea-blue sailor cap with a gently domed crown, blue band and short rear ribbons.
accessories.physics: Real inner cavity settles between/around the ears; ribbons originate from the rear band and hang under gravity.

accessories.design: A cherry-red satin hair bow with one gathered knot, two soft asymmetric loops and short folded tails at the anatomical left ear base.
accessories.physics: Mounted on the front/outer left ear base; it does not teleport to the back. Rear view shows only physically visible edge/backing through correct occlusion.

accessories.design: Two pale-lilac translucent star-shaped lenses joined by a small bridge with slim curved arms.
accessories.physics: Bridge sits above the nose, lenses align with the closed eyes, arms follow both temples; no floating or duplicate rear lenses.

accessories.design: A pale aqua short cape with a rounded shoulder yoke, two soft draped panels and small raindrop-shaped ends.
accessories.physics: Continuous garment wraps the shoulders and upper body, opens naturally at front, drapes behind and remains outside paws and tail.

accessories.design: A soft iridescent cyan-violet scarf with a rounded wrap, graceful side knot and two flowing unequal S-curved tails.
accessories.physics: Continuous hollow neck wrap; gradient and tails remain spatially consistent, retain thickness and follow gravity.

accessories.design: A slim mint-green botanical garland with tiny white lily-of-the-valley bells and delicate leaves.
accessories.physics: One continuous flexible circlet follows the head between ear bases; flowers hang downward from real stems and remain connected around the rear.

accessories.design: A soft midnight-navy asymmetrical voyage cap with layered curved panels, pale piping and a small star accent.
accessories.physics: Real cavity and fitted band follow the skull and ear bases; layered crown has thickness and does not float or intersect ears.
